title: Bias or Diversity? Unraveling Fine-Grained Thematic Discrepancy in U.S. News Headlines
reasoning: The paper focuses on analyzing thematic discrepancies and ideological bias in news media reporting using statistical methods (Multiple Correspondence Analysis). While it discusses social issues with moral/ethical implications like abortion and same-sex marriage, it does so to analyze reporting patterns and media slant rather than to evaluate or benchmark religious, spiritual, moral, or ethical frameworks themselves.
